title: Accounts Assistant
description:
An accountancy practice based in east Bristol is currently recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join their team.

Working for a well-established, independent firm that will provide AAT study support if desired, this is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to further their career within this field.

Duties will include:
- Preparing accounts for soles traders and limited companies
- Calculating VAT
- Personal and corporate tax computations
- Client query resolution
- Assist with payroll
- Other ad hoc duties within the accounting team

The successful candidate will have worked within an accountancy practice previously and ideally have experience in Sage and/or Xero.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Position: Credit Controller
Type: Permanent
Location: Bristol
Salary £28 - £30 K plus benefits.
Ref:

HSB Technical is supporting an established financial services business in the recruitment of a Credit Controller. The successful candidate will manage client sales ledgers across a varied portfolio, ensuring debts are collected promptly, records remain accurate and queries are resolved professionally.

Working closely with the Relationship Manager and wider operations team, you will help maintain ledger quality, improve client cash flow and highlight potential risks at an early stage. This role requires strong communication, attention to detail and the confidence to balance excellent customer service with effective debt recovery.

Key responsibilities
- Set up and maintain accurate client files for credit control purposes.
- Manage a portfolio of client accounts and develop a good understanding of each client's business.
- Chase and verify outstanding debts against agreed monthly targets using telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Agree repayment plans where appropriate and with the required management approval.
- Recommend accounts for legal referral where necessary and in line with internal procedures.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of all customer interactions on internal systems.
- Operate an efficient follow-up process, ensuring actions and account notes are clear and up to date.
- Review trading styles and customer information to confirm accuracy and validity.
- Issue statements and collection communications promptly, using email as the preferred method where appropriate.
- Communicate regularly with clients and provide timely updates when issues arise.
- Attend credit control meetings and contribute ideas that improve operational efficiency.
- Complete monthly sales ledger reviews with the Relationship Manager within agreed timescales.
- Ensure client and customer queries are communicated clearly and resolved promptly.

Skills and competencies
- Communication - Professional and confident when dealing with clients, customers and colleagues by telephone, email and face to face.
- Customer focus - Able to provide a responsive service while maintaining appropriate commercial and risk controls.
- Risk awareness - Able to identify potential issues and escalate concerns promptly to the relevant manager.
- Numerical ability - Comfortable reviewing invoices, purchase orders, delivery information and account data.
- Organisation - Able to prioritise a busy workload, maintain accurate records and complete tasks within agreed timescales.
- IT skills - Confident using Microsoft Office and able to learn finance and customer account systems quickly.
- Problem solving - Able to investigate discrepancies, resolve queries and agree practical next steps.

Experience and personal qualities
- Previous experience in credit control, debt collection, accounts receivable or a customer-focused financial role is desirable.
- Experience within invoice finance or a related financial services environment would be advantageous.
- A good standard of English and mathematics, with relevant GCSEs or equivalent qualifications preferred.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to account management.
- Reliable, professional and calm when handling challenging conversations.
- Able to manage time effectively and work towards call activity, cash collection and debt-turn targets.

Performance expectations
- Maintain debt-turn performance within agreed targets.
- Complete an appropriate level of call and follow-up activity.
- Achieve agreed monthly cash collection targets.
- Complete tasks and ledger reviews within required timescales.
- Deliver excellent customer service while maintaining acceptable risk levels.

Please contact Matt Smith at HSB Technical on (phone number removed) or email (url removed) for further information or to submit your CV.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Are you a confident communicator who enjoys building relationships, solving problems and getting results?

We're recruiting two Credit Controllers for a growing financial services business in Bristol. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close-knit team, develop specialist knowledge within Finance and build a long-term career with a business that actively encourages internal progression.

This isn't your typical Credit Control role. You'll manage your own portfolio of business clients, build relationships and work collaboratively to improve cash flow and minimise risk, rather than working in a high-volume call centre environment.

The role
- Manage a portfolio of business clients and their sales ledgers.
- Proactively chase outstanding invoices via telephone, email and letter.
- Build relationships with clients and their customers, resolving queries and agreeing payment arrangements where appropriate.
- Verify invoices, investigate discrepancies and identify potential risks.
- Review aged debt and complete regular sales ledger reviews.
- Work closely with Relationship Managers to monitor accounts, provide updates and maintain excellent client service.
- Keep accurate records and ensure all follow-ups are completed within agreed timescales.

About you
- Credit control experience would be advantageous, but isn't essential.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build rapport.
- Strong attention to detail, numerical ability and problem-solving skills.
- Organised, reliable and comfortable managing competing priorities.
- A proactive approach with a good balance of customer service and commercial awareness.

Full training will be provided, so this is also a great opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in financial services.

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working: Three days in the office and two from home following probation.
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
- 7% employer pension contribution, with no employee contribution required.
- Gym membership.
- Annual performance-related bonus
- Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm, with some flexibility on start and finish times.

Progression

You'll receive a structured induction and ongoing support from an experienced team. The business has a strong track record of promoting internally, with opportunities to progress into other operational roles.

If you're looking for a varied role where you can develop your skills, build relationships and progress your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller/Finance Assistant
description:
Looking for your next step in finance? Want a varied role where you can take ownership, develop your skills and make a real difference?

We're recruiting a Finance Assistant - Sales Ledger & Credit Control on behalf of a growing, family-owned business based in Bristol.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and expanding business, supporting a close-knit finance team in a varied position combining sales ledger, accounts receivable, credit control and reporting.

Importantly, this isn't just a traditional credit control role. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of customer accounts, build relationships across the business and help improve finance processes as the company continues to grow.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and raising customer invoices and credit notes.
- Maintaining accurate customer accounts and sales ledger records.
- Allocating customer payments and investigating unallocated cash.
- Reconciling the sales ledger and issuing customer statements.
- Proactively managing outstanding debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Building relationships with customers to resolve invoice queries and payment disputes.
- Negotiating payment plans and escalating problematic accounts where necessary.
- Supporting aged debt reporting, cash collection forecasts and month-end processes.
- Assessing new customer credit applications and assisting with credit limits.
- Working closely with Sales and Customer Operations to resolve issues affecting payment.
- Identifying opportunities to improve existing finance processes, systems and procedures.

You'll be encouraged to work autonomously, take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute ideas to improve the wider finance function.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with individuals who have previous experience in a finance or accounts administration, ideally with exposure to both sales ledger and credit control.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in sales ledger, accounts receivable and/or credit control.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence dealing with customers and resolving payment queries.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Experience using Microsoft Office and an ERP/finance system such as Sage, SAP or Dynamics.
- A proactive attitude, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.

Experience across both sales ledger and credit control would be advantageous. However, candidates with a strong background in either area will also be considered if they are keen to develop their wider finance experience.

AAT studies or an interest in pursuing a finance qualification would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

What's On Offer?
- 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Private healthcare cash plan.
- Study support
- Death-in-service insurance.
- Free onsite parking.
- Opportunities for further training and development, including AAT.
- The opportunity to join a growing business where you can genuinely influence and improve finance processes.
- A varied position offering exposure to different areas of finance and the wider business.

Interested?

If you're an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Sales Ledger Clerk or Credit Controller looking for a varied next step, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HR and Payroll Officer
description:
HR and Payroll Officer

This is an opportunity to bring your strong experience in both HR administration and payroll to the charity sector and help two charities develop and operate consistent working practices, with support from the Head of Resources.

The purpose of this role will be to manage payroll, and support managers with day-to-day HR, across the two charities, and assist in bringing systems together into one new platform.

Position: HR and Payroll Officer
Salary: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum, depending on skills and experience
Location: Bristol, BS16
Hours: Full time, 35 hours per week
Contract: Permanent, with joint employment split equally between two charities
Annual leave: 29 days plus bank holidays
Closing date: 9am on Monday 30 November 2026

About the role

This is a new role for someone who enjoys the variety of HR and wants to take ownership of payroll. Reporting to the Head of Resources, you ll be the main point of contact for HR and payroll across both charities, supporting managers and staff from recruitment and onboarding through to changes in pay and employment terms.

You ll also help introduce a shared HR and payroll system, with the opportunity to shape how both charities manage their processes from the outset.

Your key responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment and onboarding, from advertising vacancies and arranging interviews to issuing contracts and completing pre-employment checks.
- Maintaining accurate employee records, administering contract changes and helping managers and staff with day-to-day HR queries.
- Running monthly payroll, checking and reconciling calculations, and making sure staff are paid accurately and on time.
- Managing HMRC submissions, payroll year-end tasks, pension auto-enrolment and statutory payments.
- Supporting the Head of Resources with the new system rollout, including data migration, parallel payroll testing and training for managers and staff.

About you

You ll bring at least two years experience running payroll and supporting HR. You ll be confident using payroll and HR software and have good Excel skills.

You ll have a keen eye for detail, handle sensitive information with discretion and be able to balance fixed payroll deadlines with changing HR priorities. You ll work well with colleagues across both charities and deal with staff queries fairly and respectfully.

An HR or payroll qualification and bookkeeping skills would be an advantage.

About the organisations

One charity helps people and communities improve their lives through grants, housing and community development. The other provides training and support for adults with learning disabilities, helping people build skills and take part in purposeful, rewarding activities.

Other roles you may have experience of could include HR and Payroll Coordinator, HR and Payroll Administrator, People and Payroll Officer, Payroll and HR Officer, or HR Operations Officer.

Please note this role is advertised by the recruitment agency acting for the client Not For Profit People.

title: Transactional Finance Officer
description:
This is an exciting role for a Transactional Finance Officer to join a Bristol based business on a permanent basis. Paying 35,000, 4 days in office with amazing benefits.

Client Details

Our client is looking for a Transactional finance manager to join our team. You'll help deliver robust day-to-day financial operations, end-to-end purchase-to-pay, compliance with internal controls and support successful planning and delivery.

Description

The Transactional Finance Manager will be responsible for;
- Overseeing the end-to-end Accounts Payable lifecycle across all departments, settlements, and year-round operational overheads.
- Uphold robust purchase-to-pay controls, ensuring all supplier commitments carry valid purchase orders, and budget-holder approval.
- Act as the primary operational contact for outsourced bookkeeping partners, answering posting queries and monitoring turnaround times.
- Review and process payment batches ensuring compliance with internal control environment
- Review, verify, and code all transaction feeds, ensuring correct receipt capture, business justification, and accurate VAT recovery.
- AR ledger management and credit control
- Overseeing a team of 2

Profile

What the Transactional Finance Officer will bring;
- Substantial operational finance experience overseeing end-to-end Accounts Payable and broad transactional accounting cycles.
- Experience of managing or supervising a small team
- Knowledge of VAT including reverse charges and proper receipt compliance for VAT recovery
- Exceptional attention to detail with an investigative eye for coding anomalies, duplicate invoices, and missing documentation.
- Ability to stay composed, adaptable, and organised under pressure, particularly during delivery phases where volume and urgency surge.
- Communicate clearly and respectfully with a range of people
- Collaborate across different roles and departments
- Contribute to inclusive and accessible ways of working

Job Offer
- Permanent Transactional Finance Officer role based in Bristol.
- Salary of up to 35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Standard pension.
- Excellent benefits package
- 21 days annual leave, plus a 2 week Christmas shutdown

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Interim Accounts Payable Clerk
description:
As an Interim Accounts Payable Clerk Bath, you will help keep supplier invoices and payments moving through the accounting process during a temporary assignment. You will manage day-to-day accounts payable tasks accurately, helping the finance team maintain clear and timely records.

This is a 3 month role, which could go permanent.

Client Details

This is a fast growing business, looking to add someone with strong experience that can handle high volumes of work.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure they are recorded in the correct accounting period.
- Check invoice details against available records to help maintain accurate payment information.
- Maintain accounts payable records so finance information is clear and up to date.
- Prepare payment information for review, helping invoices move through the agreed process.
- Respond to supplier invoice queries and provide clear updates where information is available.
- Identify missing or unclear invoice details and follow up to support timely processing.
- Keep organised documentation to support the day-to-day running of the Accounting & Finance department.

Profile

A successful 'Interim Accounts Payable' should have:
- Practical experience of processing supplier invoices.
- Good understanding of accounts payable records and payment processes.
- Ability to check financial information carefully and maintain accurate data.
- Experience handling invoice queries in a clear and timely way.
- Confidence managing routine accounting tasks during a temporary assignment.

Job Offer
- Temporary Accounts Payable assignment in Bath.
- Hourly pay of 13 to 16, dependent on the level of experience.
- 3 month contract, possible to go permanent.
